description: The connected person's Comidoc Premium status: whether it is active, the plan, its renewal date, credits left, and the page where they manage it. Requires an OAuth connection with account:read; nothing sensitive is returned. Without a connection, the server answers 401 with an OAuth challenge.
name: get_my_access

manage_url.description: Page where the person manages or cancels Premium, signed in on comidoc.com.

access.description: unlimited: every course_url goes straight to Udemy with the coupon applied in the person's browser signed in to comidoc.com. credits: one credit per coupon opened. none: no Premium, course_url shows the Premium offer. Coupon codes are not included.

access_ends_at.description: When Premium ends if it does not renew; null for lifetime or renewing plans.

active.description: Whether the person has Comidoc Premium right now.

premium_offer.description: The plan currently sold, only when the person has no Premium.

title: Get my Premium access
